Synthetic Vorbis decoder fixtures, generated by generate.cpp under the repository's MIT license.
No game recording is included. The encoder is the project's pinned libvorbis 1.3.7,
quality 0.6. Each input plane is 12000/32768 * sin(2*pi*(220 + channel*110)*frame/rate).
Vorbis limits the sixth plane's LFE bandwidth; tests compare the other five to their tones.

mono.ogg: 8000 Hz, one channel, 2400 input frames.
stereo.ogg: 48000 Hz, two channels, 14400 input frames.
surround.ogg: 48000 Hz, six channels in Vorbis order, 14400 input frames.

To regenerate, compile the existing dependency's lib/vorbisenc.c with its lib/ and
include/ directories, the libogg include directory and generated/ogg-config on the
include path. Link that object and generate.cpp against the build's libpt_vorbis.a.
Run the resulting generator with <output.ogg> <rate> <channels> <frames> as above.
Encoding tools are not required to build or run the tests.
